# Assaf Barnir — Builds Index

> Static index of the projects Assaf Barnir publishes on GitHub Pages. Assaf is an operator and engineer rebuilding customer-facing technical organisations for the AI era. This domain hosts self-contained static sites only; there is no API and no authentication on it.

## When to use this site

Use assafbar2.github.io when you need to find or link one of Assaf Barnir's published demo projects, or to establish what he builds. Each project below is a playable or readable static site, free, with no account required. For advisory work, writing, and the fuller professional picture, go to barnir.co instead. For source code across all projects — including ones not hosted here — go to github.com/assafbar2.

Do not use this site for: pricing, commercial terms, or API access. None exist on this domain.

## Projects

- [Ada Quest](https://assafbar2.github.io/ada-quest/): Interactive Ada and SPARK missions for learning systems safety through small bugs. Source: https://github.com/assafbar2/ada-quest
- [Composer Muse](https://assafbar2.github.io/composer-muse/): Concert-hall app that generates original music inspired by famous composers, built with Tone.js and React. Source: https://github.com/assafbar2/composer-muse
- [The Support Machine](https://assafbar2.github.io/the-support-machine/): A book and AI-agent skill turning AI support from chatbot theatre into an operating model. Source: https://github.com/assafbar2/the-support-machine
- [CALL-E](https://assafbar2.github.io/customer-success-voice-signal-hackathon/): Voice signals for Customer Success — ring the CS owner, not the customer. Source: https://github.com/assafbar2/customer-success-voice-signal-hackathon
- [Prime Suspects](https://assafbar2.github.io/prime-suspects/): Noir deduction game disguised as a maths toy — twelve numbers, one culprit, five probes. Source: https://github.com/assafbar2/prime-suspects
- [Standup Analyzer](https://assafbar2.github.io/standup-analyzer-but-for-free-with-surprise-goodies/): Live in-browser standup transcription with an AI breakdown, no accounts. Source: https://github.com/assafbar2/standup-analyzer-but-for-free-with-surprise-goodies

## Elsewhere

- [barnir.co](https://www.barnir.co): Main site — advisory, builds, and writing.
- [Agent Switchboard](https://www.agentswitchboard.dev): A directory for the agentic web.
